resources.string: A wallet is an app on your phone that holds your digital money. LatiFi opens it so you can sign in. We never see the secret code that unlocks it.
I do not have a wallet

Install a wallet app from Google Play and create your account in it. Write down the recovery phrase it gives you (a list of words that can restore your wallet) and keep it private. Nobody at LatiFi will ever ask for it. Then come back and tap Connect wallet.
Check that your wallet app is installed and open, then try again.
By connecting you accept the %1$s and the %2$s.
Your wallet will ask you to sign a short message. This only proves the wallet is yours. It does not move money and costs nothing.
Your session ended for your safety. Confirm again to continue where you left off.
That confirmation did not work. Try again.
Too many attempts. Wait %1$d seconds and try again.
What do you want to do first?
Post a request and receive funds from a lender.
Review requests and fund the ones you trust.
You can change this later in Profile.
Open your wallet app and check for a pending request. If nothing appears, reconnect your wallet.
You declined the request in your wallet. Nothing was sent.
Your wallet connection ended. Reconnect to continue.
